title: Percussion navigator
description: A detailed percussion waveform stays connected to a draggable overview as you pan and magnify its transients.
useCase: Navigating audio, sensor signals, or other dense time series while keeping the full sequence in view.
interaction: Drag the overview window or choose 1×, 2×, 4×, or 8× magnification
reducedMotion: All waveform navigation is immediate; reduced motion also removes control color transitions.
limitations: One deterministic 12-second synthetic percussion signal; no audio playback, media import, trimming, or real-time recording. Min/max envelopes sample the same data at both scales.
look: Deep burgundy backdrop with a cream panel showing a crimson filled waveform on faint gridlines, monospace time labels, a segmented zoom control and a minimap.
motion: Dragging the minimap window with the pointer pans the detailed waveform, and the 1×–8× buttons rezoom around the current centre; both redraw the min/max envelope instantly, untweened.
adapt: `view` (start, span) feeds the detail `signalPath` and window position, `zoom` keeps the centre fixed, and pointer handlers shift `start` within `DURATION`. Replace `samples` (and the precomputed `overview`) with decoded audio or sensor data.
